notes: 104 wood timbers: eight unsupported lower bands removed; eight roof rafters and eight horizontal ceiling spokes added. One continuous half-inch horizontal plywood assembly represents sheet goods; fabrication seams remain undesigned.
Existing 40% keyed cuts and old fit/clearance/assembly claims are superseded.
Ground and member-bearing heights remain unresolved.
Short rafter end faces are exact plane intersections; they are not finished housed or tenoned joints.
Proposed step-lap joinery using chosen design assumptions. This is not fabrication, strength, uplift, stability or erection approval.
The original reference image is undimensioned. Selected widths and engagement are not measurements from it.
The owner-uploaded timber-frame manual has not been read; externally verified TFEC 1-2019 is not that attachment.

Model selection binds meshes, plans, exports, removed-stock overlays and recomputed applied self-weight to the selected geometry. Baseline contact warning markers and fixed-area pressure shortcuts are disabled for the proposed model; reactions and capacities remain unsolved.

All 24 requested matching perimeter interfaces are represented in the separate proposed model: 16 short-rafter/ring and 8 main-hip/post joints. The canonical baseline stays unchanged; this is not structural or fabrication approval.
